0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0, 2-0 at home, on a three-game winning streak and 1st in the Atlantic) host the Detroit Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) in Philadelphia's fourth game of the 2026-27 season. The two teams have not played each other yet this season, and in 2025-26 the 76ers lost the season series 0-4, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while Jabari Walker (knee) and Joel Embiid (rest) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions; Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain), and Ausar Thompson (ankle, sprain) is a day-to-day game-time decision.
